data.one_liner: Predefined Flutter widgets for Supabase authentication forms and social login.
data.what_it_does: Provides pre-built UI components such as email/password forms, magic link forms, phone verification inputs, password reset, and social sign-in buttons connected directly to Supabase authentication. Supports localizations and standard Flutter theming.
use_when: You are building a Flutter app using Supabase for backend authentication.
You want standard sign-in and sign-up screens without writing auth form UI from scratch.
avoid_when: You are using a backend other than Supabase.
You require custom design systems that cannot be styled via standard ThemeData and input decoration themes.
strengths: Speeds up development of authentication screens for Supabase projects.
Built-in support for native Google and Apple sign-in options alongside web OAuth.
Supports localization and custom field validation rules.
weaknesses: Strictly tied to Supabase as the backend provider.
Limited to predefined form widgets and configurations.
data.setup_notes: Requires configuring Supabase deep links and setting up native client IDs for Google and Apple sign-in where applicable.

alternatives.name: firebase_auth
alternatives.why_pick_it: Choose this if you are using Firebase instead of Supabase for your backend.
